name: nexus-skills
description: Skills for the nexus MCP and nunu.ai platform.

interface.longDescription: Codex skills for authoring repeatable nexus verification tests and refining flaky tests by comparing passing and failing run history.
defaultPrompt: Use verification-test-authoring to turn these acceptance criteria into a repeatable nexus verification test.
Use verification-test-authoring to review this nexus test and tighten any ambiguous checks, goals, or hints.
Use flaky-test-refinement to compare these passing and failing run IDs, explain the divergence, and stabilize the test.
Use flaky-test-refinement to analyze this test plan's inconsistent results across configs and propose precise fixes.
